The problem المشكلة

Opening a small business in Jordan means a maze of offices, papers and fees.

Which legal structure should I register? أي شكل قانوني؟
Which office do I go to first? من أين أبدأ؟
Which papers do I need, and where do I sign? ما الأوراق؟
How much will it all cost? كم التكلفة؟

Layla wants to open a home bakery in Irbid.

9

steps to register a home business

~15 days

from start to licence

305–520 JOD

official fees

The rules sit across the Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply, the municipality, JFDA, the chambers, the tax department and Social Security. Today she pieces it together from websites, queues and word of mouth.

بداية Bedaya
The solution الحل

One website, one SANAD sign-in, and a guide who does the paperwork with you.

  • Sign in with SANAD. Identity is verified and the owner's details are filled in, after they approve exactly what is shared.
  • Saad prepares the work. A brief, a launch plan, the letters and the official forms.
  • The owner decides. Nothing counts until they approve it, then they sign with SANAD.
  • Every fee and step is sourced from official Jordanian data.
بداية Bedaya
Meet Saad سعد · المستشار الذكي

Saad studies the business and prepares everything in four stages.

1

Understand

Picks the legal structure and writes a brief of the business.

2

Plan

Where to go, what to sign and where, papers, fees and a tip per step.

3

Documents

Writes letters and fills the official forms.

4

Sign & submit

Approved forms go to SANAD signing and the office.

brief, plan, letter or form

Not yet? Edit it yourself, or ask Saad to change it ("make it shorter"), and review again.
VersionedEvery AI draft and every approval is saved as a new version.
LoggedAn activity log shows what the AI did and what the owner did.
GatedOnly approved forms reach signing. A changed structure marks old drafts out of date.
بداية Bedaya
Legal structure الشكل القانوني

Saad compares the structures and recommends one, with reasons.

Home business Sole proprietorship مؤسسة فردية LLC ذات مسؤولية محدودة General partnership تضامن Limited partnership توصية بسيطة Private shareholding مساهمة خاصة Non-profit غير ربحية
  • Each option shows owners, liability, official fees, steps, choose it when and watch out.
  • For Layla: a home business, because she works from home and it is the cheapest, fastest way to start.
  • The owner decides. Switching rebuilds the roadmap from the official rules, after a confirmation.
بداية Bedaya
Ask Saad اسأل سعد

A friendly character on every page answers in Arabic or English.

  • Knows the client. Progress, next step, missing papers and funding matches, read on the server.
  • Exact numbers. When Bedaya can compute the answer, such as total fees, the model only rephrases it.
  • Grounded. Answers are built from official data retrieved for the question, with links to sources.
  • Stays on topic. Poems and football get a polite no, without calling the model.
  • Remembers. Past chats are saved to the account and reopen on the Assistant page.

Four parties, one platform لكل طرف حسابه

Each party signs in to its own account and sees only its own work.

Owner

Business owner

Works with Saad, follows the roadmap, uploads papers with automatic checks, signs with SANAD, applies for funding and builds the brand.

Partners

Bank & incubator

Each has an inbox of applications sent to it. They review and decide; the owner sees the decision.

Experts

Advisers

Publish their own free times and see or cancel bookings. A taken slot can't be double-booked.

Admin

Bedaya team

Manages rules, partners and roles, sees analytics, and plays each government office to approve or return signed forms.

0 JOD

no API key, no usage bill

Local

no client data leaves the machine

~20 tokens/s

on a 6 GB laptop GPU, through Ollama

Offline

answers take over if the model is off or slow

Grounded, not trained: how one answer is made

QuestionThe owner asks, in Arabic or English.
RetrieveOfficial fees, papers, offices and timings for that question.
Client factsTheir progress and documents, read on the server.
Verified answerBedaya computes the numbers it can; the model must use them.
Safe outputStreamed reply, escaped before display, with sources.

What is real الحقيقي والتجريبي

Real data where it matters, clearly marked simulations where it can't be yet.

Real

  • Fees, steps, times, offices and papers from MIT eRegulations, GAM, JFDA, the chambers, ISTD and SSC
  • Support programmes: JEDCO, DEF, Orange Corners, Oasis500, QRCE, iPARK, Luminus
  • Social Security and income-tax rates
  • The open-source AI model, running for real

Simulated for the MVP

  • SANAD sign-in and signatures (labelled as a demo)
  • Document reading (OCR) and government form templates (stamped "demo form")
  • The partner bank, appointment slots and zoning areas
  • Domain purchase, hosting, and email or WhatsApp sending
بداية Bedaya
Live demo · 5 minutes عرض مباشر

Follow Layla from SANAD sign-in to a signed form.

  1. Login with SANAD and approve. Layla lands on Saad.
  2. Legal structure: Saad recommends a home business, with reasons.
  3. Study my business: Saad writes a brief; ask for a change, then approve.
  4. Build my plan: where to go, how to sign, papers, fees and a tip per step.
  5. Documents: the landlord letter as a branded PDF, then the official forms.
  6. Sign with SANAD and watch the form go to the office.
  7. Ask Saad: "How much will all the fees cost me?"
  8. Launch Studio and the bank / admin side of the platform.
